 Published By : News Desk Last Updated: 17 Oct 2026, 04:01 pm IST Share
 The Kerala Karunya KR-772 lottery result for Saturday, 17 October 2026, has been announced by the Kerala State Lotteries Department. Check the winning ticket numbers, complete prize list, first-prize winner and details on how to verify the official results. 
 Representational image (Photo: Mathrubhumi) The Kerala State Lotteries Department has announced the results of the Karunya KR-772 lottery draw held on Saturday, 17 October 2026. The draw offers a first prize of ₹1 crore, followed by second and third prizes of ₹25 lakh and ₹10 lakh, respectively.
 Ticket holders can check their ticket numbers against the winning numbers published in the official results list. The complete results should be verified against the official Kerala State Lotteries Department notification before any prize claim is made.

 02:49 pm (IST) | 17 Oct 2026 How to check the Kerala Karunya KR-772 result 
 Ticket holders should follow these steps to check the result:
 Visit the official Kerala State Lotteries Department website.
 Open the results section and locate the Karunya KR-772 draw dated 17 October 2026.
 Download the official results PDF.
 Check the ticket number and series printed on the ticket against the published winning numbers.
 Confirm the result with the official notification before proceeding with a claim
 02:48 pm (IST) | 17 Oct 2026 Kerala lottery prize claim rules 
 Winners must retain their original tickets and follow the verification and claim procedures prescribed by the Kerala State Lotteries Department.
 The original winning ticket should be signed on the reverse and submitted with the required identification and supporting documents within the prescribed deadline. The applicable claim office depends on the prize amount and the department's current rules.
 Lottery winnings may be subject to applicable income tax and other authorised deductions. Winners should check the latest official instructions to establish the net amount payable and the documents required for their particular prize category.
